scope: source/docs/history text <=4 MiB per file; environments, binaries and symlinks excluded; bounded at 100 MiB/15 seconds
limitations: Patterns are leads, not confirmed secrets or exhaustive PII findings; matched values were not copied. Production data/history must never enter the public tree.
triage: Signed-query hits are synthetic tests; token-shaped hits are embedded Google/Kaggle archived website configuration, not confirmed user credentials. No value was validated or exported; archives excluded.
